description: Windows 복사 이름의 추가 컷을 이미지 전환 목록에 등록

! JO9 image-cycle: saved choices are keyed by original image path. if $args[0] = 'jo9_path': local $jo9_base, $jo9_path, jo9_count, jo9_selected $jo9_base = $lcase($replace($args[1], '\', '/')) $jo9_path = $args[1] jo9_count = 1 jo9_selected = jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_base] if jo9_selected < 0: jo9_selected = 0 if $jo9_base = 'content/pic/bg/stasis_bank.png': jo9_count = 3 if jo9_selected = 0: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/bg/stasis_bank.png' if jo9_selected = 1: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/bg/stasis_bank_2.png' if jo9_selected = 2: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/bg/stasis_bank_3.png' end if $jo9_base = 'content/pic/characters/sabrina.png': jo9_count = 2 if jo9_selected = 0: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/characters/sabrina.png' if jo9_selected = 1: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/characters/Sabrina_2.png' end if $jo9_base = 'content/pic/characters/tsyuansu.png': jo9_count = 2 if jo9_selected = 0: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/characters/Tsyuansu.png' if jo9_selected = 1: $jo9_path = 'content/pic/characters/Tsyuansu_2.png' end if jo9_selected >= jo9_count: jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_base] = 0 $jo9_path = $args[1] end jo9_image_count = jo9_count $result = $jo9_path exit end if $args[0] = 'jo9_html': local $jo9_html, $jo9_tail, $jo9_src, $jo9_attr, $jo9_newsrc, $jo9_saved_html, jo9_at, jo9_next $jo9_html = $args[1] if instr($jo9_html, ' 0: jo9_next += jo9_at - 1 $jo9_tail = $mid($jo9_html, jo9_next) $jo9_src = $strfind($jo9_tail, 'src\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', 1) if $jo9_src ! '': $jo9_visible_top = $lcase($replace($jo9_src, '\', '/')) $jo9_newsrc = func('interior_change', 'jo9_path', $jo9_src) $jo9_attr = $strfind($jo9_tail, 'src\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"') $jo9_html = $replace($jo9_html, $jo9_attr, 'src="' + $jo9_newsrc + '"') end jo9_at = jo9_next + 4 jump 'jo9_image_scan' end if $jo9_visible_top ! '': $jo9_newsrc = func('interior_change', 'jo9_path', $jo9_visible_top) if jo9_image_count > 1: $jo9_last_button = '
' $jo9_html += $jo9_last_button end end $result = $jo9_html exit end if $args[0] = 'jo9_toggle': local $jo9_before, $jo9_after, $jo9_current_html, $jo9_before_attr, $jo9_after_attr, jo9_match, jo9_searchpos, jo9_last_match if $jo9_visible_top = '': exit $jo9_before = func('interior_change', 'jo9_path', $jo9_visible_top) if jo9_image_count < 2: exit jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_visible_top] = (jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_visible_top] + 1) mod jo9_image_count $jo9_after = func('interior_change', 'jo9_path', $jo9_visible_top) $jo9_current_html = $maintxt $jo9_before_attr = 'src="' + $jo9_before + '"' $jo9_after_attr = 'src="' + $jo9_after + '"' jo9_searchpos = 1 jo9_last_match = 0 :jo9_find_top_attribute jo9_match = instr($mid($jo9_current_html, jo9_searchpos), $jo9_before_attr) if jo9_match > 0: jo9_last_match = jo9_searchpos + jo9_match - 1 jo9_searchpos = jo9_last_match + len($jo9_before_attr) jump 'jo9_find_top_attribute' end if jo9_last_match = 0: jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_visible_top] = (jo9_cut_choice[$jo9_visible_top] + jo9_image_count - 1) mod jo9_image_count exit end $jo9_current_html = $mid($jo9_current_html, 1, jo9_last_match - 1) + $jo9_after_attr + $mid($jo9_current_html, jo9_last_match + len($jo9_before_attr)) *clr *p $jo9_current_html refint exit end ! End JO9 image-cycle; original home room switching follows. !Move to a different room in your apartment !Created by crushboss !gs 'main_layout' if change_interior = 1: interior_num += 1 if interior_num > 7: interior_num = 1 if interior_num = 1: $place = 'bedroom_lux' if interior_num = 2 and bath > 0: $place = 'bathroom_lux' elseif interior_num = 2 and bath = 0: interior_num += 1 end if interior_num = 3 and dungeon > 0: $place = 'dungeon_lux' elseif interior_num = 3 and dungeon = 0: interior_num += 1 end if interior_num = 4 and kitchen > 0: $place = 'kitchen_lux' elseif interior_num = 4 and kitchen = 0: interior_num += 1 end if interior_num = 5 and lab > 0: $place = 'lab_lux' elseif interior_num = 5 and lab = 0: interior_num += 1 end if interior_num = 6 and boudoir > 0: $place = 'boudoir_lux' elseif interior_num = 6 and boudoir = 0: interior_num += 1 end if interior_num = 7: $place = 'home_lux' change_interior = 0
